<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Re-lands the AITER preshuffled FP8 block-scale GEMM (#51692 by @simondanielsson, #56433 by @mawong-amd), which #57132 reverted after DeepSeek-V4-Pro GSM8K fell to 0.0008. This version finds and fixes that cause, folds in @bichowdh's #56234 (tuned-shape gate), and makes the plain blockscale GEMM the first choice: the preshuffled GEMM only takes shapes whose plain AITER table is less tuned than its own.

Draft. Still to run on this head: DeepSeek-V4-Pro GSM8K and a GLM-5.3 sweep with the new priority rule.

## Claims

- **DeepSeek-V4 accuracy cause, fixed.** `DeepseekV4MoE` builds `shared_experts` before the fused MoE. Their FP8 linears were shuffled in their own post-load step, and then `prepare_heterogeneous_shared_expert` / mega MoE copied the shuffled bytes as if they were the checkpoint layout. The shared experts are now marked `skip_weight_relayout` when a fused MoE copies them. DeepSeek-V4-Pro TP8 GSM8K: 0.0008 before the fix, 0.957 after (main: 0.954).
- **The plain GEMM comes first.** `AiterPreshuffledFp8BlockScaledMMKernel.can_implement` refuses when AITER's plain `a8w8_blockscale` table has at least as many tuned batch sizes for (N, K) as the `a8w8_blockscale_bpreshuffle` table, so selection falls through to `AiterFp8BlockScaledMMKernel`. With both tuned they perform the same (table below), and the plain GEMM needs no weight relayout. The preshuffled GEMM still serves shapes only its table covers, e.g. Qwen3.8-27B on gfx950 (0 plain rows, 160 preshuffled).
- **N guard is `N % 16`** instead of `N % 128`, so shapes like DeepSeek-R1's `fused_qkv_a_proj` (N = 2112) qualify.

## Validation

**GLM-5.3 TP4, MI355X, one node** (`amd/GLM-5.3-Quark-MXFP4-AttnFP8`, vLLM nightly `5d35ce39`). Four arms, total throughput vs the kernel-off arm, 11 points (8k/1k at concurrency 4-256, 60k/600 at 4-32). "Tuned plain GEMM" adds 88 gfx950 rows to AITER's plain table (ROCm/aiter#7381) through `AITER_CONFIG_GEMM_A8W8_BLOCKSCALE`.

| Arm | Geomean | 8k c4 | 8k c64 | 8k c256 | 60k c32 | GSM8K (200) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Off (plain GEMM, AITER's current rows) | baseline | | | | | 0.99 |
| Preshuffled GEMM (previous head) | +6.8% | +0.6% | +7.1% | +12.2% | +12.4% | 0.99 |
| Plain GEMM, tuned rows | +7.1% | +1.5% | +6.4% | +11.8% | +12.2% | 0.995 |
| Both | +6.8% | +0.6% | +7.2% | +12.1% | +12.4% | 0.99 |

The two GEMMs tie once both are tuned, and they do not stack. That is why the plain GEMM now has priority.

**DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 TP8 GSM8K** (5-shot, 1319 questions, the #57132 setup, `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1`):

| Build | strict-match |
|---|---|
| Nightly, kernel off | 0.9538 |
| Previous head (re-land without the fix) | 0.0008 |
| Previous head, fused shared experts off | 0.9530 |
| Fix + #56234 (row-major quant, then transpose copy) | 0.9568 |

The final head keeps the transposed-scale quant (`group_fp8_quant(transpose_scale=True)`) rather than #56234's transpose copy: on GLM-5.3 TP4 it was about 2% faster, with the GPU halves swapped between two pairs. The scale layout is covered by `test_rocm_fused_qkv_quant_matches_preshuffled_gemm_scale_layout`.

**Pending on this head (905d521)**

| Check | Status |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V4-Pro GSM8K, TP8 | pending |
| GLM-5.3 TP4 sweep with the plain-first rule, with and without aiter#7381 | pending |
| Qwen3.8-27B: tuned plain GEMM vs preshuffled GEMM | pending; decides whether the preshuffled path is still needed |
| DeepSeek-R1 GSM8K | pending |
| New tests (ROCm only) | not run yet |

## Details

**Changes against the reverted code.**

- `vllm/_aiter_ops.py`: `blockscale_tuned_m_count(n, k, preshuffled)` counts the sampled batch sizes (M = 1 to 32768) with a tuned row, through AITER's own `get_CKGEMM_config` lookup. `is_blockscale_bpreshuffle_tuned` (the #56234 gate) and `prefers_plain_blockscale` build on it.
- `scaled_mm/aiter.py`: the plain-first check in `can_implement`; the `N % 16` guard; layers marked `is_bmm` or `skip_weight_relayout` keep the plain layout and run the plain GEMM; the e8m0 scale upcast now runs before that early return; shuffled linears are tagged `aiter_bpreshuffled`.
- `deepseek_v4/amd/model.py`: `skip_weight_relayout` on the shared experts when a fused MoE copies them.
- `deepseek_v4/amd/rocm.py`: `weight_already_preshuffled()` reads the `aiter_bpreshuffled` tag.
- Tests: `tests/kernels/quantization/test_aiter_preshuffled_blockscale_selection.py` (priority rule), and in `tests/models/test_deepseek_v4_vl_rocm.py` a test that fused shared experts keep the checkpoint layout, plus the earlier `wo_a`, `gate_up_proj` and scale-layout tests.

**Trade-off.** The tuned-shape check probes 15 batch sizes per (N, K) once at startup (cached). A shape whose plain rows cover fewer batch sizes than its preshuffled rows still picks the preshuffled GEMM, even if the plain rows would be as fast at the sizes that matter.

**Related PRs.**

- ROCm/aiter#7381 adds the GLM-5.3 plain-table rows used above.
- #56502 by @eky-amd (fusion patterns for the transposed-scale quant) applies on top of this.
- #63217 adds the gfx1250 preshuffled path. #63604 adds a DeepSeek-V4 bpreshuffle switch and touches the same shuffle code.

@@ -0,0 +1,64 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The plain AITER blockscale GEMM is preferred; the bpreshuffle one only takes
+shapes whose plain table is less tuned than its own."""
+
+import importlib.util
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm._aiter_ops import rocm_aiter_ops
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.scaled_mm.aiter import (
+    AiterPreshuffledFp8BlockScaledMMKernel,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.scaled_mm.ScaledMMLinearKernel import (
+    FP8ScaledMMLinearLayerConfig,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.quant_utils import (
+    kFp8Dynamic128Sym,
+    kFp8Static128BlockSym,
+)
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+pytestmark = [
+    pytest.mark.skipif(
+        not (current_platform.is_rocm() and importlib.util.find_spec("aiter")),
+        reason="Requires ROCm + aiter",
+    ),
+    pytest.mark.usefixtures("default_vllm_config"),
+]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("plain", "shuffled", "picks_bpreshuffle"),
+    [
+        (0, 15, True),  # plain table empty: bpreshuffle covers the shape
+        (6, 15, True),  # plain tuned at a few M only
+        (15, 15, False),  # tie: keep the checkpoint layout
+        (15, 6, False),
+        (15, 0, False),  # bpreshuffle untuned
+        (0, 0, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_plain_blockscale_gemm_has_priority(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, plain: int, shuffled: int, picks_bpreshuffle
+) -> None:
+    def tuned_m_count(n: int, k: int, preshuffled: bool) -> int:
+        return shuffled if preshuffled else plain
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        rocm_aiter_ops, "blockscale_tuned_m_count", staticmethod(tuned_m_count)
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rocm_aiter_ops, "is_linear_fp8_enabled", lambda: True)
+    config = FP8ScaledMMLinearLayerConfig(
+        weight_quant_key=kFp8Static128BlockSym,
+        activation_quant_key=kFp8Dynamic128Sym,
+        input_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        out_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        weight_shape=(2048, 4096),
+    )
+
+    ok, reason = AiterPreshuffledFp8BlockScaledMMKernel.can_implement(config)
+
+    assert ok is picks_bpreshuffle, reason

@@ -142,6 +142,147 @@ def expert_reference(x, gate_up_weight, down_weight):
     torch.testing.assert_close(actual.float(), expected, rtol=0.02, atol=5e-5)
 
 
+def _preshuffled_fp8_linear(
+    holder: str = "quant_method", weight_shape: tuple[int, int] = (256, 128)
+) -> nn.Module:
+    pytest.importorskip("aiter")
+    from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.scaled_mm.aiter import (
+        AiterPreshuffledFp8BlockScaledMMKernel,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.scaled_mm.ScaledMMLinearKernel import (
+        FP8ScaledMMLinearLayerConfig,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.quant_utils import (
+        kFp8Dynamic128Sym,
+        kFp8Static128BlockSym,
+    )
+
+    config = FP8ScaledMMLinearLayerConfig(
+        weight_quant_key=kFp8Static128BlockSym,
+        activation_quant_key=kFp8Dynamic128Sym,
+        input_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        out_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        weight_shape=weight_shape,
+    )
+    layer = nn.Module()
+    layer.weight = nn.Parameter(
+        torch.randn(*weight_shape, device="cuda").to(current_platform.fp8_dtype()),
+        requires_grad=False,
+    )
+    layer.register_parameter(
+        "weight_scale" if holder == "scheme" else "weight_scale_inv",
+        nn.Parameter(
+            torch.ones(*(dim // 128 for dim in weight_shape), device="cuda"),
+            requires_grad=False,
+        ),
+    )
+    setattr(
+        layer,
+        holder,
+        SimpleNamespace(fp8_linear=AiterPreshuffledFp8BlockScaledMMKernel(config)),
+    )
+    return layer
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("holder", ["quant_method", "scheme"])
+def test_rocm_wo_a_keeps_row_major_weights(holder: str, default_vllm_config) -> None:
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.rocm_aiter_mla_sparse import _get_cached_wo_a_bf16
+
+    layer = _preshuffled_fp8_linear(holder)
+    layer.is_bmm = True
+    original = layer.weight.detach().clone()
+    kernel = getattr(layer, holder).fp8_linear
+    kernel.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+
+    actual = _get_cached_wo_a_bf16(layer, 2, 128, 128)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, original.to(torch.bfloat16).view(2, 128, 128))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("holder", ["quant_method", "scheme"])
+def test_rocm_fused_shared_expert_keeps_checkpoint_layout(
+    holder: str, default_vllm_config
+) -> None:
+    # The fused MoE copies the shared expert's weights after this step.
+    layer = _preshuffled_fp8_linear(holder)
+    layer.skip_weight_relayout = True
+    original = layer.weight.detach().clone()
+    getattr(layer, holder).fp8_linear.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+
+    assert not getattr(layer, "aiter_bpreshuffled", False)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        layer.weight.view(torch.uint8), original.view(torch.uint8)
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("holder", ["quant_method", "scheme"])
+def test_rocm_gateup_shuffles_once_and_down_proj_keeps_preshuffled_backend(
+    holder: str, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, default_vllm_config
+) -> None:
+    from vllm._aiter_ops import rocm_aiter_ops
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v4.amd import model as rocm_model
+
+    gate_up, down = _preshuffled_fp8_linear(holder), _preshuffled_fp8_linear(holder)
+    original_gate_up = gate_up.weight.detach().clone()
+    original_down = down.weight.detach().clone()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        rocm_model, "MergedColumnParallelLinear", lambda *a, **k: gate_up
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rocm_model, "RowParallelLinear", lambda *a, **k: down)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rocm_aiter_ops, "is_enabled", lambda: True)
+    model = rocm_model.DeepseekV4MLP(128, 128, "silu")
+    for linear in (gate_up, down):
+        getattr(linear, holder).fp8_linear.process_weights_after_loading(linear)
+    model.prepare_gateup_preshuffle()
+
+    for linear, original in ((gate_up, original_gate_up), (down, original_down)):
+        expected = rocm_aiter_ops.shuffle_weight(original, layout=(16, 16))
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            linear.weight.view(torch.uint8), expected.view(torch.uint8)
+        )
+
+
+def test_rocm_fused_qkv_quant_matches_preshuffled_gemm_scale_layout(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, default_vllm_config
+) -> None:
+    from vllm._aiter_ops import rocm_aiter_ops
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v4.amd.rocm import (
+        DeepseekV4ROCMAiterMLAAttention,
+        apply_pre_quantized_block_scaled_mm,
+    )
+
+    if not rocm_aiter_ops.is_blockscale_bpreshuffle_tuned(1024, 256):
+        pytest.skip("Requires a tuned AITER preshuffled FP8 GEMM")
+    linear = _preshuffled_fp8_linear(weight_shape=(1024, 256))
+    original = linear.weight.detach().clone()
+    linear.quant_method.fp8_linear.process_weights_after_loading(linear)
+    attention = DeepseekV4ROCMAiterMLAAttention.__new__(DeepseekV4ROCMAiterMLAAttention)
+    nn.Module.__init__(attention)
+    attention.wq_b = linear
+    attention.indexer = None
+    attention.q_lora_rank, attention.head_dim = 256, 128
+    attention.eps = 1e-5
+    attention.q_norm = SimpleNamespace(
+        weight=torch.ones(256, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    )
+    attention.kv_norm = SimpleNamespace(
+        weight=torch.ones(128, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rocm_aiter_ops, "is_linear_fp8_enabled", lambda: True)
+    # Multiple rows and groups with different ranges expose byte-order errors.
+    inputs = torch.randn(16, 384, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    inputs[:, :128] *= 4
+    quantized, scales, _ = attention._split_qkv_and_norm(inputs)
+    assert scales is not None
+    output = apply_pre_quantized_block_scaled_mm(linear, quantized, scales)
+    q = inputs[:, :256].float()
+    normalized = q * torch.rsqrt(q.square().mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + attention.eps)
+    reference_scales = normalized.view(16, 2, 128).abs().amax(dim=-1)
+    reference_scales /= torch.finfo(current_platform.fp8_dtype()).max
+    dequantized = quantized.float() * reference_scales.repeat_interleave(128, dim=1)
+    expected = dequantized @ original.float().T
+    torch.testing.assert_close(output.float(), expected, atol=0.125, rtol=0.01)
+
+
 def test_rocm_packed_kv_cache_auto_uses_ds_mla_layout() -> None:
     from vllm.config import CacheConfig
     from vllm.models.deepseek_v4.attention import _resolve_dsv4_kv_cache_dtype

@@ -256,6 +256,26 @@ def _triton_gemm_config_is_tuned(config_name: str, N: int, K: int) -> bool:
     return get_gemm_config(config_name, M_TUNE_PROBE, N, K)[1]
 
 
+# Batch sizes probed when asking whether a blockscale GEMM shape is tuned.
+_BLOCKSCALE_SAMPLE_M = (
+    32768,
+    8192,
+    4096,
+    2048,
+    1024,
+    512,
+    256,
+    128,
+    64,
+    32,
+    16,

issue_comments.body:
Hello @amd-sriram! Thank you for this PR.
This PR will improve performance for Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 on MI355X and MI350P by 25-50% as well. There are other draft PRs that tries to implement the same logic: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56502, https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56234
It would be wonderful if this PR is merged!

The PRs with tuned bpreshuffle FP8 blockwise GEMMs in AITER:
- mi355x https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6033
- mi350p https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6939
